name: Genre Conformity
description: Analyzes genre style conformity against established statistical baselines for human writing versus AI generation.
mechanism:
This method analyzes genre conformity for AI text detection following Uchendu et al. (2020):

1. **Genre Classification**: The text is classified into its genre/domain (academic, journalistic, conversational, creative fiction, technical documentation, social media, etc.) using stylistic and structural features — sentence length distributions, vocabulary complexity, formality markers, and discourse structure.

2. **Genre-Specific Feature Extraction**: Features specific to the detected genre are extracted. Each genre has distinct characteristics: academic writing uses passive voice, hedging language, and citation patterns; journalism uses inverted pyramid structure and attribution; creative writing uses figurative language and varied sentence rhythm.

3. **Conformity Assessment**: The text's adherence to genre conventions is measured. Human writers naturally conform to genre expectations through learned writing conventions and audience awareness. AI-generated text may show: (a) genre mixing (formal vocabulary with informal structure), (b) surface-level genre markers without deep genre understanding, (c) generic language that fits no specific genre.

4. **Statistical Genre Profile Comparison**: The text's statistical profile (word frequency distributions, part-of-speech patterns, syntactic complexity metrics) is compared against reference profiles for the detected genre. Deviations from expected genre statistics — particularly in higher-order features like discourse coherence and rhetorical structure — indicate potential AI generation.

5. **Genre Conformity Scoring**: A conformity score is computed measuring how well the text matches its expected genre profile. The score considers multiple dimensions: lexical conformity, syntactic conformity, structural conformity, and pragmatic conformity. Low overall conformity or inconsistent conformity across dimensions suggests AI generation.
parameters:
Analysis type: statistical
Media: text
Input: Raw text string
Minimum text length: 100 characters
Output: Confidence score (0-100)
Processing: Client-side NLP analysis
accuracy: Moderate to High — 65-85% standalone accuracy. Performance increases significantly when combined with complementary text analysis methods. Results vary with text length, language, and content type.
source: Statistical NLP analysis methods for AI-generated text detection. Based on computational linguistics and information theory research.
useCase: Detection of AI-generated text through genre conformity analysis. This method examines specific linguistic patterns that differ between human-written and AI-generated text, providing complementary evidence in a multi-method analysis pipeline.
strengths:
• Fast client-side analysis with no server required
• Effective as part of a multi-method analysis pipeline
• Works across various text types and genres
• Based on established linguistic research
• Complements other statistical text analysis methods
limitations:
• Best used in combination with other text analysis methods
• Performance varies with text length (requires sufficient text)
• May be affected by text language and writing style
• Accuracy depends on the AI model used for generation
• Human writing can occasionally trigger false positives

references.title: Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
Jawahar, G. et al. (2020). Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey. COLING.
